chronicleSignature.description: ES256 cryptographic signature proving record authenticity

kid.description: Key identifier for the signing key

nonce.description: Unique random nonce to prevent replay

deviceProgress.description: Per-device progress bucket. Buckets are summed across devices (not max-merged) so in-app activity spread over multiple devices is fully counted.

deviceId.description: Random per-install device id from userScopedStorage. No fingerprinting.

drainActive.description: Whether drain is actively ticking (true while exploring, false while resting or camping). Walks have no frozen state.

heartbeatProgress.description: Session progress counters at heartbeat time (per-device bucket contents)

main.description: Walk record. Created with status 'active' at first engagement (first tracked action on the feed), kept current with putRecord, and updated to 'completed' when the walk closes (idle auto-close, light depletion, or a manual wrap-up). rkey is a TID. Walks are the everyday unit and are never numbered; identity is the record key and display identity is the walk's time. Tracks the full lifecycle of a walk including camps, gathered findings, light consumption, and conditions.

activeDuration.description: Active exploring time in minutes (excludes camp/rest time)

campsCount.description: Number of camps made during the walk

closedBy.description: How the walk closed. Known values: 'user' (manual 'that's enough for now' tap), 'auto' (idle auto-close after the inactivity window), and 'lamp' (light depleted). Free string with no enum so future close reasons need no lexicon change. Unset while the walk is active.

completedAt.description: When the walk ended. For idle auto-closes this is the last tracked activity, clamped to be no earlier than startedAt.

status.description: Current walk status. A walk is 'active' while open and 'completed' once it closes; there is no 'abandoned' state because a walk never fails.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated

lightLevel.description: Time-of-day light condition at walk start

userState.description: User fatigue state at walk start

walkElsewhereActivity.description: Cross-client activity during the walk window that did NOT happen in anisota: the PDS scan of app.bsky posts/likes/reposts in the walk window minus the in-app per-device summed totals, floored at 0 per field. Because likes and reposts carry no client marker this is a subtraction estimate, so the elsewhere panel labels it 'at least'. This block NEVER earns XP or findings; it is data for the panel only. Optional; unset when there was no elsewhere activity or the scan was unavailable.

likesSent.description: Likes sent elsewhere during the walk window (scan minus in-app; at-least estimate)

postsCreated.description: Posts created elsewhere during the walk window (scan minus in-app)

repostsSent.description: Reposts sent elsewhere during the walk window (scan minus in-app; at-least estimate)

walkFindings.description: What was found/gathered during the walk

walkHeartbeat.description: Periodic snapshot of walk progress for cross-device sync

lastActivityAt.description: Timestamp of the last tracked activity. Drives the idle clock and is max-merged across devices (heartbeats themselves fire on a timer, so idle detection must key on this field, not updatedAt).

progress.description: Per-device progress buckets, one entry per device that has contributed to this walk. In-app totals are the SUM across buckets, not a max-merge: per-device buckets exist deliberately so multi-device in-app activity is never undercounted (an undercount would falsely inflate the elsewhere figure).

walkLight.description: Light resource tracking for the walk

atEnd.description: Light level when the walk ended (in minutes)

atStart.description: Light level when the walk started (in minutes)

consumed.description: Total light consumed during the walk

drainRate.description: Effective drain rate as a percentage (80 = 0.8x drain). Multiply by 0.01 to get the float multiplier.

regenerated.description: Total light regenerated during the walk's camps

status.description: Light status at start of the walk
